capabilities.description: Separates test executions, observations, candidates, validation attempts and confirmed findings.
Builds a fail-closed, redacted program-policy, identity, request and workflow assertion workspace; does not send requests.
Models all ATT&CK campaign tactics with approval, telemetry, stop, evidence and cleanup fields.
Exploit, credential, persistence, defense-evasion, lateral, C2, exfiltration and impact evidence must come from separately governed operator infrastructure.
Statically linked bounded argv-only Linux process executor; Python remains authoritative and safely falls back.
